projects.title: INSOPHINIA POS — Next.js Edition
highlights: Billing, receipt printing, returns and cancellation workflows with barcode/PLU lookup, loyalty points and quantity-based promotions
Role-based access, audit/security events and optional two-factor authentication, with a live dual-screen customer display
AES-256-GCM encrypted backups with seven-day retention and configurable local or S3-compatible cloud fallback
projects.description: A self-hosted point-of-sale application for retail shops: billing, inventory, customers and loyalty, manual email and WhatsApp receipts, and encrypted backups — deployable on a local workstation, self-hosted containers or Supabase.

projects.title: INSOPHINIA POS — React + Spring Boot + Desktop Edition
highlights: One Spring Boot REST API and MySQL 8 database shared by a React/Vite web client and a JavaFX desktop client
Email verification and TOTP two-factor authentication lifecycles, role-aware dashboard, and PDF/CSV/JSON report exports
Billing concurrency integration tests on Testcontainers MySQL, plus Vitest and Cypress end-to-end coverage
projects.description: A multi-client point-of-sale system where the web and desktop apps talk to a single Spring Boot REST API that alone owns the MySQL database, with Flyway migrations, dev/test/prod profiles and a Docker-ready backend.

projects.title: INSOPHINIA POS — PHP + MySQL Edition
highlights: Framework-free PHP 8.2 port with a custom router, 38 JSON API endpoints and a fully offline-bundled Bootstrap UI
JWT sessions with token blacklist, CSRF protection, rate limiting, account lockout, audit logging and 4-role × 33-permission RBAC
Atomic stock updates, A4/thermal PDF receipts, email and WhatsApp sharing, and one-command Docker/Podman setup
projects.description: A pure PHP and MySQL point-of-sale system covering billing, inventory, customers, warranties, repairs and marketing campaigns, with a security model matching the original Next.js edition and simple deployment via Docker, Podman, Apache or Nginx.

projects.title: Pentest Report Generator
highlights: CVSS v3.1 base scoring plus a CWSS-inspired Composite Risk Score (0–100), with optional NVD CVE enrichment
Per-project sharing, hardened evidence uploads and rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection
Versioned HTML, Markdown and PDF report exports with sha256 checksums
projects.description: A self-hosted penetration-testing report generator: track engagements and findings, score them with CVSS v3.1 and a CWSS-inspired risk score, and export professional HTML, Markdown and PDF reports — running on SQLite and the filesystem with no external services.
